claim_boundary: This probes whether current Task 2 fact gold source documents can be retrieved from the current knowledge seed. It uses fact claim/evidence text as probe queries, not a broad user-query distribution.

commands.command: uv run python -m nlp_term.retrieve.diagnose --facts data/gold/task2_fact_gold.json --knowledge data/knowledge_seed.json --output model/metrics/retrieval_bottleneck_diagnosis.json

uv run python -m nlp_term.validators --metric-claim model/metrics/retrieval_bottleneck_diagnosis.json --input data/gold/task2_fact_gold.json --require-dataset-origin task2_gold --require-claim-level sanity
uv run ruff check src tests

diagnostic_summary.coverage_signal: All 25 Task 2 fact gold source_doc_id values exist in current knowledge and appear within top 3 for fact-style probes.
diagnostic_summary.ranking_signal: Only 15 of 25 facts are ranked at top 1. Label 2 has the weakest top1 rate at 0.4.
diagnostic_summary.scope_warning: Because probes use fact claims and evidence quotes, this does not prove user-question retrieval quality.
diagnostic_summary.next_action: Use this together with Task 2 answer evaluation to prioritize more realistic user-query data and source expansion, especially for academic calendar and graduation/curriculum cases.
